summary: The library advocates for maintaining E-Rate funding to ensure affordable and reliable Internet access for patrons.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate would threaten library's ability to provide Internet access
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate is critical for our library to maintain affordable, reliable access to the Internet for our patrons. Cutting E-Rate would threaten our ability to provide Internet access because we don’t have dedicated resources to fill the gap in funding.
